sections.heading: Clinical onboarding & launch sequence
sections.subheading: A collaborative 4-week timeline designed to fit around your doctors' busy clinic schedules.

steps.title: 1. Practice Profiling
steps.body: Gather doctor bios, consulting hours, department lists, and acceptable insurance partners.

steps.title: 2. Clinical Build
steps.body: Develop secure pages, intake forms, scheduling logic, and verify SSL encryption.

steps.title: 3. Reception Testing
steps.body: Train front-desk staff on handling calendar bookings, test SMS alerts, and review flow.

steps.title: 4. Patient Go-Live
steps.body: Point official domain, announce online booking on social channels, and go live.

sections.heading: Healthcare terms & standards
sections.subheading: Guaranteed confidentiality, security, and transparent deliverables.

terms.title: Milestone payments
terms.body: 50% upfront to initiate project development, 30% upon approval of design and booking workflows, and 20% before final live deployment.

terms.title: Patient data security
terms.body: All patient intake forms and booking logs are encrypted. Web-App never stores, shares, or accesses patient health records after handover.

terms.title: Physician content accuracy
terms.body: The clinic reviews and approves all medical bios, departmental descriptions, and health guidance before public launch.

terms.title: Warranty & ongoing care
terms.body: Includes 30 days of comprehensive technical support and optional monthly maintenance for regular backups and updates.

sections.calloutBody: Prices are fixed development estimates for the scope listed. Applicable taxes, if any, will be stated separately. Final scope and milestones will be confirmed in a written agreement.
